# mcu-max

The [Litch-Max engine](https://github.com/foxieproducts/litch-max/blob/9594558de4a95065d455e996471affb188b08a99/README.md) includes a modified copy of Gissio’s mcu-max 1.0.7, derived from H.G. Muller’s micro-Max 4.8. The Litch commit pins the engine revision through the `lib/litch-max` Git submodule. Follow the [checkout instructions](../../README.md#building-or-repairing-litch) to obtain that source.

The [engine provenance](https://github.com/foxieproducts/litch-max/blob/9594558de4a95065d455e996471affb188b08a99/docs/mcu_max_provenance.md) records the upstream commit, local changes, MIT notice and author’s permission for micro-Max. See the [vendored MIT license](https://github.com/foxieproducts/litch-max/blob/9594558de4a95065d455e996471affb188b08a99/vendor/mcu-max/LICENSE) and [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) when redistributing the engine. The [vendor comparison tool](../../tools/vendor/README.md) can verify the changes against upstream.
